Absolutely wonderful.... First, the sound is fantastic! And tied for first is the OUTSTANDING design! Sleek, simple and gorgeous. My favorite sound is brown noise. The ONLY problem with this app is that when I play the noises with the oscillation feature (which is like an exquisite brain massage!) I can't play the app in the background, because even though the app closes and the sound continues, a big square with the volume icon won't go away...and blocks my view. I hope this will be fixed!

If it were not for this major flaw, it would be perfection.

Glitchy. They need to fix some glitches. Volume icon won't disappear when oscillation is on, kind of annoying if I want the noise while I browse or whatever. Also range of oscillation needs some tweaking.

I could not be more pleased.... It's working fine with iOS 7, it's on a charger, I'm using an iPhone 5s, and it's masking my neighbor's annoying heat pump. I'm using white noise over a Bluetooth speaker between me and the heat pump and it's steady rather than oscillating. The only problem, and it probably won't bother you, is that it keeps making me think about the TV in "Poltergeist". If I should suddenly hear a disembodied voice saying "They're baaaack!" I'll not be very surprised.

I wish they'd fix this app.... Great app for iOS 6 and it's got some issues for iOS 7. Most annoying is that the iPhone volume screen shows up when in other apps while this is running....volume is very odd and flaky. Please update it soon!

Sanity saver!!. 3 weeks ago, I developed a steady ringing in my ears which drove me crazy the first two days. I have been adapting to it, but I guess it's also got me stressed since I'm not sleeping well. This app helps to mask the tinnitus and make it tolerable, and somewhat helps me sleep. I need to work on some relaxation techniques too, because my insomnia is really bad. But the app is very helpful to make the ringing less noticeable and I recommend it for anyone with tinnitus.

Not updated for iOS 7. The app behaves strangely on iOS 7. Oscillator doesn't work. Volume adjustment doesn't work with the buttons. Volume knob appearance changes and the volume is hard to get just right. 

Wait for an update before buying.
No fuss just calm. Very helpful study aid for those of us distracted easily.

🆘 Needs a serious update. iOS 7 broke the sound. I loved this app in iOS 6, but in 7 the audio is too soft. Also, the oscillation spread needs to be smaller. It's too extreme from silent to loud now. Oscillation is what made this app the best for me. I loved the variation in white noise volume. It made the sound more organic. I hope they update to iOS 7 soon.

Good but..... So this app is gorgeous, easy to use, and cool if you JUST WANT SIMPLE NOISE. I didn't read when I purchased but it doesn't have anything else like rain, fire, etc. BUT for what it does provide it does it very well.
Ringer disabled. The app disables the ringer. Good thing I awoke to the sound of vibrations. Please fix. I am on call for work and need to hear my ringer.

Poor decision. Pretty glitchy. It doesn't work right when plugged in to a dock which is a huge pain. The oscillation is the only compromise for me and my husband and it won't work when plugged in. He's the only reason I got it. I'm looking for a better app right now. I wish I hadn't bought it.

Glitchy after iOS 7. I loved this app on my iPhone 4S while it still had iOS 6. With iOS 7, I've noticed the oscillation effect lowers the brown noise to almost 0%, regardless of whether it oscillation is set to high, medium, or low. Totally defeats the purpose. Hope this is just temporary.
Please update. Please update for ios 7, it's glitchy.
Some bugs. With oscillation on, if you exit the app the volume graphic stays on so you can't see. Also when you watch a video both the app and the video player mute.

Perfect for Newborn Daughter. My daughter immediately relaxes when she hears Brown Noise. I either run it through our sound system or just keep the phone nearby. This app is a lifesaver and baby soother!

Does not work on iOS 7. This is a great app for concentration, or sleeping. Now that I have updated to iOS 7, the app does not work right. Setting the volume glitches the app, and the oscillation will go between some volume and mute. 

Other apps were updated for iOS 7, why not SimplyNoise?

Good product, poor integration.. The app stops emitting noise if the screen rotates. Highly impractical for me, I use the Smart Alarm app, as well, which requires the iPad to be on the bed. If I bump my iPad during the night, it often turns off the SN app, and I wake up from the sudden lack of noise. I set the SN sleep timer so it'll ideally stop playing right before my alarm, to make for an easier wake-up. The app also stops making noise once you travel away from the SN home screen. I can't use it for studying in this case.

I still love Simply Noise on my computer, it's just a bummer than I can't use it on my iPad.

reviews.text: Sounds like static. The sound is like static on the radio, not rain. I want my money back!

Good quality--needs a few improvements. Excellent work for a simple sound generation app. The interface is clean, the sounds are high quality, and the options are uncluttered.

However, developers need to address a few issues:

 On occasion, around the selection buttons, an indented square appears in the same manner as the "water droplet" animation after pressing a button, as if the animation extends into the edges of the button's defined area on the screen. It's strange and greatly affects the visual UE. Either adjust the animation to be smaller, widen the button AOE on the screen for the animation, or change the animation to a simple indent like in your other app, SimplyRain.

 Timers do not always work. Sometimes, although a timer is set for one hour, I wake hours later to the app still running and playing noise. This is annoying and defeats the purpose of a timer. It also interferes with my alarm clock on occasion, which is not something my boss would like to know.

 In-app and device volume should be identical. When in-app or device volume is adjusted, it should be reflected as a 1:1 ratio on the other source, the two sources being in-app and device. This would make it easier to precisely adjust the volume when the device screen is off.

Once these aesthetic and usability tweaks are made, this app will become one of the best noise generators on the App Store.
Great!. I love this app because it blocks out all the noises I dislike, and it works really well!

I like it but it's SLOW. I like this app. I use it daily at the office. But it bugs me how long it takes to load and actually start playing. It really seems like it should be almost instantaneous but it's not. Every single time I start it up to use it I think to myself "Come on already!" And what's with the completely unnecessary animations for all the buttons? Rip out all the fluff, make it as small and efficient as possible, and then maybe it will load and play immediately...

Best App on my phone. No more jet and train noise all night.

And those darn black helicopters and alien mother ships, just kidding, those fly over the mayors house down the street.

Just what I wanted!. My old white noise app had become so bloated and had so many irrelevant updates to make it fancier and fancier, that I finally went looking for something else. This was exactly what I wanted. 

I only ask one thing: with most music/noise apps, when you unplug the aux cord or headphones, the noise stops. It doesn't with this one. Can that please be an option? Turning it off is just one more fumbling step in a busy morning.
A good nights sleep. I have had about a week of sleeping through the night since I started using this app. That's not normal for me and quite welcome. Can't beat it for 99 cents.

Doesn't work with a docking station. I was really disappointed to find out after I bought and downloaded the app, that once I connected my iPad to my docking station, the app wouldn't play over the speakers. If it weren't for that, I would have given it a 5 star rating.
Worth it!. I use the brown noise option everyday in the morning when my kids are getting ready for school, when I visit my in laws house, or at a hotel. Definitely got my money's worth.
Great app, if you don't use a dock. I didn't read all the reviews before i bought it- so i didnt see that this app doesnt work when the iPad is in a dock. Pity, now i can't use it.

Simple, Functional. The elegantly simple UI combines functionality and artistic design. It's so straightforward it doesn't even require any explanation. 

Aid sleep, concentration, calm, or create a sound buffer between yourself and a crowd--a soft bubble of sound.

It has been a saving grace for me since I have Aspergers and it helps me stay calm. I love this and Relax Melodies.
Life saver. Shared a hotel room last night with a creaky radiator and my snoring brother. This app is the only reason I was able to fall asleep. Thank you!
Simply rain. Please add the rain sounds to an update!!! Otherwise it's great.

Not sure what happened to this app. I used to love this app at work, to keep me from being driven completely crazy by my coworkers, but now it constantly "skips." It cuts in and out and it's maddening. I have an iPhone 4, so not the latest, but the app used to work perfectly. It's not useable now.
Can u add that rain noise?. Please add that rain noise!!!!! I bought this app just for that function but I can't find it.... Waiting for that update, plz!!

Love it. This really helps me fall asleep when I can hear my roommates moving around in the living room. The only problem I have is the timer. I'm a really light sleeper so I wake up immediately when the timer ends and the app shuts off so I would recommend that we be able to set what time we want it to stop rather than the amount of minutes. It'd be easier than calculating how much sleep I'm going to get. Other than that it works great!

Oh thank you. White noise so I can work while my coworker screams into the phone all day! Seriously I was close to pitching her out a window or at the very least slapping her with my keyboard. So nice to block out her voice and feel normal again!!!!

Wasn't sure it would work!. Very happy with the performance of this APP. I use it to block out noise outside my home. It helps me sleep, as I'm very attuned to my neighbors making noise. This is saving my sanity. My dog is calmer too!

Perfect!. My brother does his hw at the desk next to me and he's always making noise with tapping, gum, or something else. This blocks out all of his sounds and is very relaxing. I would love it if you could add Rain and Beach sounds too!
Works magic in many scenarios.. Whether I'm trying to focus, diffuse stress, get work done, drowned out background noise...this app is a priceless utility. Simple, useful, great resource.

Student with tinnitus. I think I may have found a "cure" for my tinnitus. I found this app on a whim and did some reading today using the white noise, about 50% volume and Bose over the ear headphones. I used to listen to relaxing music without words, such as Yanni, but even that can be distracting. For me, the white noise isn't so much masking the ringing, but sort of picks it up and blends it in so it isn't as noticeable. As someone who prefers quiet, it can be maddening to be forced to keep the tv or radio on just to cover up the ringing. I can't remember what silence sounds like! White noise is an acceptable compromise.

A Must-Have for Daily Use. Unless you're fortunate enough to have a large house with good soundproofing between rooms, this is an app that you need and will use daily. The white- (or in my case "brown-") noise effect, when used with your earphones, sounds a lot like a calming rain outside the window (either gentle, or if need be, heavy). It does a terrific job of blocking out the sounds of TV, music, or conversations from the next room. If you are like me, in that you often retire in the evening before others in the family, set the app's sleep timer, put your phone on your bedside table, and drift off to sleep without any disturbance from the next room. I've used it daily for at least the last year or two. It's one of those apps that I am genuinely enthused about and would never part with. (And by the way, contrary to previous reviewers' claims, it does work in docks. To get it to do that, you need to turn the app on first, set it's sleep timer, and then insert your phone into the dock. Following that procedure, you should have no problem.)

Doesn't work with docking!!!!!!!!. This would have been a 5-star review, as the sound is great, especially the brown noise: nice and deep and steady. However, it DOES NOT WORK IN ANY DOCK!!!! Pretty much ruins the app for me.

Just what I wanted. This is the perfect solution to study anywhere at any time. It even helps me sleep. This is invaluable! The brown noise is amazing, especially combined with oscillation. Must have!

Don't Bother With Others. I tried other noise generators and they are inferior for annoying reasons, such as skips in the constant noise, or you can't turn off the screen, or you can't run other apps simultaneously. This is te best.
The best.. Perfect for white/pink/brown noise enthusiasts. Great interface and features, leagues above similar apps! Highly recommended.

Simply Amazing!. As someone who spends a lot o time woking in noisy coffee shops, this app and a pair of closed ear circumaural headphones allow me to concentrate. The user interface is a model of good design principals. The selection of different white noise types means there is always something for your aural preference/situation. Oscillation is fantastic. Good for falling asleep, as well.

Better than the White Noise app. I used the free web version for a while and was glad to pay the $1 to support it. Then I found the app version is even better. Clean design and it can keep playing in the background.

Only reason I didn't give 5 stars is it crashes sometimes. Kind of frustrating for a relaxation app. Still quite happy with it.

LIFESAVER. I work in a 24 hour call center, and have been diagnosed with High Functioning Autism. And I find it hard to unwind from work when I come home at night. My girlfriend works for UPS and finds it hard to sleep during the day, especially with her insomnia.
This app really came through for us. I can FINALY come home at night and be able to go right to sleep. I wake up in the morning and not even realize that Kira came home, and I find her sleeping next to me. We don't even wake up when the other crawls in bed!! I wish it worked on my dock tho :/
Perfect. This app does exactly what it's supposed to do. I use it for sleeping and it's great!

Wow!. I have tried at least a dozen of these noise app things. I probably have 200+ sounds to choose from amongst all the sleep/noise apps I now own. I was looking for something to help me fall asleep and cover up outside noises so that I would stay asleep. Most apps are ok, a few are close but none were perfect until I tried this app out and WOW. It is perfect! My favorite is the brown sound with pink being a close second. I love it so much that I am actually reviewing it which is something I am usually too lazy to do.

Really nice app. Downloaded the free version and only needed 1 minute to decide to buy it. Great tinnitus masking sounds. I get tired of the music I usually listen to. The oscillation feature is very soothing.
Doesn't work when docked!. It worked fine until the last update, now it's no go with a dock.

Best white noise app I've tried. We just had a baby, and babies love white noise, so I've downloaded about six or seven of these apps in an attempt to find a decent one. This is it!

Most of the apps have about a million different sounds, and most of the apps have a terrible UI for navigating those sounds. This one's different. It's only got white, pink, and brown noise, so the UI can be much simpler, and I think that's about 90% of your use cases anyway. It's also got a feature where it periodically varies the volume of a sound, which gives a nice organic effect to what might otherwise sound too artificial. Combined with brown noise, it sounds kind of like ocean waves or rainfall. Most importantly, the baby loves it!

I think the devs would do better, by the way, if they featured the UI more prominently in the App Store images. The UI is what's going to sell this app, so show it off!

I use this app everyday! Helps with sleep and attention.. I have insomnia and listening to brown noise while I sleep drowns out distractions which helps me fall asleep easily. I use white noise for when I study and it truly helps me stay on track. I have problems with focusing and keeping attention on a subject and this helps me stay "in the zone". Anyone with sleep issues or attention problems will benefit from this app.
Excellent purchase. Worth every penny, give it a try you won't be disappointed.
Law School. Brown noise with oscillation is great for studying... Television noise that could be heard through music is not heard with it on!
Perfect. The best thing since peanut butter and banana sandwiches!

Could be better. The random oscillation of volume is not in fact random, just up and down to same volume levels. I wish there was a setting u could save as your sleep timer . I have to push like 6 keys to get to this each night. Seems like it would be easy enough to give it the additional setting to do so

Great studying app!. I use this app's brown noise with the high oscillation setting to study. The brown noise cancels out the nonsense around me and the oscillation keeps me alert enough to study rather than fall asleep. Great app but I'd love some rain or wave sounds (hold the seagulls please) in the next update!

Great App produced From a Great Website!. Found their website during my crazy studying days of college. Heck, I'm still in college, but now, I have opted to purchase their app because of all of the help it has provided. Used brown noise to drown out my school's ridiculously loud library, my noisy roommates when we shared the living room as a homework zone, and my roommate at night when her iHome's volume was loud enough to wake the dead. 

Thanks to this app I've maintained my productivity level and my sanity! Thanks SimplyNoise! 

It would bw great to have love some new noise options if possible. (Nature Scapes)

Just got better (awesome background for studying). You can now do everything the we app can do!! I have been waiting along time for the app to allow you to adjust the oscillation and now you can! As a medical student it is easy to study in any setting with this app and a good pair of head phones!
Excellent white noise app. I love this app. The brown noise function is the perfect pitch to help me sleep.

Must have app. Using this on my computer has been a lifesaver. I am now getting it on my iPad so that I can always have it with me. If you need to be to focus in a noisy environment, you need this app.
Good. Love the sound but why can't the off button be on the main screen instead of inside settings?
Great noise blocker. A lot of white noise apps are too high-pitched. I love the brown noise setting on this app. Great for blocking out ambient noise for sleeping.

Absolutely stunning!. I have long wanted something to play white noise when I study and have asked many people about where to find something that would work. Lo and behold, a friend showed this to me yesterday. 

The quality of sound is spectacular and is very effective at blocking everything out. You have complete control of what is playing so it completely suits your needs. And it's nice to be able to use the iPod while the noise still plays.

Finally able to read in public again. I've used this on my computer before and was ecstatic when I saw they had an iPhone app. Perfect if you're irritable/sensitive to noise but like to read or do work in public places like a coffee shop. In the past, I'd just find some music to play, but even that could get distracting. Beyond worth the $.99!

Fair. Pros:
1. High quality audio samples
2. Repeats forever without any pops or clicks ever
Cons:
1. Does not obey headphone unplug event, continues playing sound over the speaker when headphones are unplugged, this is incredibly obnoxious
2. App volume control is independent of iPhone master volume, why do we need two volume controls??
3. UI dissolve effects are superfluous, the additional wait before I can start to use the controls is really annoying
Amazing.. No words to be said about it.

Can't get any simpler!. I never would have thought the sound of White or Pink noise would help me sleep or focus on something. 

It does exactly what it's supposed to do. Well worth a dollar! 

One thing, the disappearing buttons are kind of unnecessary.

Still the best. Used the website for years, but now I can use this app and headphones to sleep peacefully without bothering my wife. I can use it at work without question. Love the minimalistic interface too.
Love the oscillating option!. What a great idea, perfect for when I need to sleep and neighbors are playing music. Wish I had this years ago.

really great. I know there are other apps with lots of frills but this is all I need :) 
only reccommendation with regards to oscillation is that it would be nice to control the degree, I find the change in volume to be a little too much, and therefore a bit distracting, so I just don't use it.

Love it!. I've been a fan of the SimplyNoise website for sometime and I'm more than happy to pay the ninety nine cents for the app. White noise is perfect for studying and the brown noise helps me get to sleep. 

This is definitely one of the best out there.

Simplicity, but a simple request.. This works wonderfully. I have been a long time user of the website version and was a bit disappointed to find that there's no way to control the oscillation speed.

Could we please have this added in the future? It would make the app perfect.

Another minor detail, the definition on the icon could be a little sharper for the higher resolution devices, but perhaps I'm being too critical!

Well worth $.99 nonetheless!

Helps me focus. I am a student of an online university and my classroom is wherever I can find a free wifi hotspot, no matter how crowded or noisy it may be. I've been using simplynoise on my laptop for a couple years, but really enjoy the app because it allows me to block out anything, anywhere. I initially used the lite version, but very quickly purchased the full one because of the "beige" noise. Beige provides a somewhat bassier version of white noise that blocks deep voices and noises much more effectively. Really nice product, big fan.

Helps this ADD student focus!. I have major ADD and this app helps to drown out all that distracting background noise! I love the oscillating feature. If only I could download the thunderstorm from the app that would be perfect. But I just downloaded it direct from the website for my iPhone. Well worth the $$$! Would have paid more! :)

Cr*p. This may be the dumbest app I have ever purchased. Sure it drowns out exterior sounds, but it does so with annoying static. Save your 99 cents. Go out and buy a radio, tear off the antenna and viola, white noise.

A dollar and a dream. I was using Sleep Machine Lite for a while until an update made it useless on my iPhone 3G. So every night I had to put my iPhone 4 into airplane mode and plug it into a speaker so that my baby would fall soundly to sleep. A parent needs white noise almost as much as they need a pacifier. I tried EVERY free app out there and only this one had the brown noise that I needed. The best white noise I've heard.
Won't stack w/Pandora. I was hoping that it would play at the same time as Pandora, another background-audio enabled app, but apparently it's either/or. Bummer.

A very nice implementation. This works perfectly, it's a bit minimal (you can't layer the noises on top of each other, control the oscilation rate, etc) but the lack of fiddliness in the settings is totally in line with its purpose: to create a simple, relaxing environment. I plug in my ipad and use it to soothe my baby down, or to dim out noise when I'm trying to sleep.

Doesn't play on Apple TV. It does what it says, plays white noise, but my stereo is hooked up to my Apple TV and it won't play wirelessly to that (as far as I can tell). Better to download a track from iTunes if you have a wireless setup.
Worth all 99 pennies. It does exactly what it says it does, create white, pink, and brown noise in a non cyclic fashion.
Nice for .99, could be better. Really like it for helping put the baby down!!! Would get 5 stars if it had a way to change the noise. More controls that would tweak sound quality???
Awful. This app isn't worth .99 cents!!! It will give you a migraine, that's about the only thing it will do. Save your .99 cents!!
Great app. I use it work to keep focused and drown out coworker small talk. Works well.
Life saver. Let's me sleep despite noisy roommates. Love the oscillation and brown noise :)

Almost perfect. Love this app. Well-designed and very useful. 

If I could change anything, I'd add more ambient noise choices - not thunderstorms, but more industrial sounding stuff. 

Either way, love it.

Really great app!. This app is a great replacement for my white noise generator at home. I am using it right now to drown out street and hotel noises in Downtown Chicago. It works like a charm. The only thing that could improve it is if you could adjust the tone within each different color of noise. I got the right tone by putting a plastic container over the speaker. Otherwise, love it.
It's good. True brown noise, exactly what I needed. Look elsewhere for "nature sounds", they never seem to soothe me anyway. Great for light sleepers. Nice simple UI.

Top study tool. I am literally using this app right now to read my school text book and taking notes in a crowded noisy Starbucks, but all I hear is simple noise the only noise I need in my head yet, I can still hear my thoughts as I study. Thumps up

Great app, needs refinements. Great sounds, but doesn't behave smoothly like other audio programs. Can't use headphone controls to stop/restart. Doesn't restart after phone call. Also, timer function is inconsistent - seems to stop countdown sometimes. 

Otherwise great sound quality, nice fade in and out.
Waste of money. Big disappointment, looking for soothing nature sounds, 3 notes, boring
Great in my iHome !. I can't sleep without this app anymore! The city is loud and this app lulls me to sleep like I'm laying on the beach.

Essential for concentrating on tough projects. So, I'm working on a dissertation proposal and sometimes distractions are much more enticing than staying focused on the work. I don't strive to block noise completely-- I value my hearing too much for that-- but Simply Noise gives me a focal point so that I can stay on track. Darn. ,-)

Perfect!. This App is exactly what I needed for help with my occasional tinnitus. I cannot listen to music to drown out the ringing when I try to sleep, the inconsistency of the sound disturbs me. The white noise generated by this provides me the consistent background noise I need to mask my tinnitus. Very well done and highly recommended.

Great app for working in a coffee shop. I first used simply noise two years ago via its website when trying to work on a computer in a coffee shop with net access. It can be set to muffle the ambient noises without drowning them out totally. It definitely raises my productivity.

Great app. Used to burn in a new pair of headphones. 100 hours of pink noise and my headphones sounded great! Also experimented with the brown noise and pink noise for sleep and office use - worked exceptionally.
Great app. This app is awesome! .99 cents was well worth it. Now riding the train is a pleasure. I can't hear all the idiots on their cell phones. ,)

Helpful. I suffer from moderate tinnitus, which is getting worse quickly. SimplyNoise, brown noise particularly soothes my ears so nicely, especially before I sleep. It is like a massage for my ears and it covers my tinnitus enough to where I am no longer waking up at 5 am anymore because of some ringing in my ear. Thanks so much.
A non medicinal sleeping pill. I have used this for months now instead of taking melatonin. I love it. Serves it's purpose. The timer is my favorite feature-ensures my sleep until the alarm goes off
VERY nicely done. The quality of this Ap is on par with Apple Original aps. The sounds are so pure. Love the oscillation feature. Great job.

Only App I've ever paid for. The brown noise is my favorite, which the free version doesn't have. Easy to use, dimmer is very handy, allows multi tasking, and timer shut off. Wish the shutdown button were more accessible, but if we're taking wishes I'd prefer a quiet neighbor who didn't think he was in a "band".

Probably the best 99 cents I've ever spent.. I use simplynoise to block out the frustrating inanity of the world. I find the brown noise on oscillate to be very effective in filtering out possible distractions. The best part is I can use it while reading because it, unlike music, does not constantly interrupt my train of thought.
Simplynoise. Awesome. Well worth the whole .99 it costs. I find the brown noise the best of the three. Works excellent for studying in a noisy area.
Awesome!!!!!. I highly recommend this app to everyone!

Amazing Migraine and Insomnia aid!. I have been using Simply Noise for about a year now. I just recently purchased the app because I wanted to support the people behind this magnificent sleep aid! I get many migraines too painful to describe in a short review as well as insomnia which goes goes hand-in-hand with the migraines. The brown noise has reduced my migraines and has helped me get a wonderful, deep sleep! If you're on the fence about this app I hope this review has given you a gust of wind towards the "buy it" side! Trust me, the full version is, by far, MUCH better than any other white/pink/brown noise app on any device! Thank you, Simply Noise!

The best I've found. I previewed nearly all of the white noise generators in the app store and was disappointed to find that none of them worked in the background.

I installed Simply Noise Lite and found exactly what I was looking for The lite version completely met my needs but I felt guilty so i popped for the 99 cents.

This is the perfect companion to iBooks in a noisy environment. 

Thank you Simply Noise.

Great sound app!. This may be one of the most useful and productive apps I've ever purchased. The sound quality is premium.

I use it to eliminate distractions at work andI plug it into our alarm clock "dock" and our baby falls asleep and stays asleep.

It is much better than a fan for noise. Headphones can help you isolate the noise and make it very portable. And, for 99 cents it is cheaper than a fan.

Lastly, the features allow you to turn off the noise on a timer, vary the noise from white- to pink- and to brown (my personal favorite), and oscillate the pitch which is protective of your hearing.

Enjoy this great app, you won't be disappointed.

Favorite new thing. I am not one to write reviews, but I had to make an exception for this app. I absolutely love it. Downloaded it last night with a little hesitation, but now it is my favorite thing. I love the shutoff timer on it. I slept so sound with this last night, can't wait to use it again.

Exactly what I was looking for!. I am hopelessly dependent on white noise to sleep and forgetting my sound machine when I travel was the worst. This is a perfect substitution on the go. Love the brown noise! I also love that it stays on after exiting the app. Thanks a lot!
Absolutely lifesaving.. I am more than willing to support the most used app on my phone. Money has never been so well-spent.

Peace and concentration. This app saved me from a 6 hour flight sandwiched between a barking dog, a crying baby, and an annoying mother. Wow! Thank you Simplynoise. It is also fantastic if you're trying to study, or want some peace at times when you don't really want to listen to music to drown out other sounds. In fact, I would say that the white noise drowns out background noise much better than listening to music. When I have this thing turned on, I can't hear a thing! This is seriously a MUST have app.

Download free on site. I like the lite version. Decided to support the developer by purchasing app because it offered thunderstorm. Bought app. Than was directed to website for free thunderstorm download. The app is almost same as lite version. Get the free version.

Simple, Elegant, and Effective. My wife stumbled across this and uses it to soothe the children in her daycare. I was skeptical but decided to give it a try. I found it to work so well that I had to buy the app so that I could use this at work and while at school. It's fantastic and a wonderful idea.

Awesome. Does what it claims well. If you want to block background noise or have it replace silence with calm neutral sound this app does great. Brown noise sounds like being on a jet, this is my favorite noise.

SimplyNoise, will you marry me?. I've loved the website for a while, and this app is no exception.

To the complainers: This app is "Simply" "Noise." It not SimplyNoise + nature noise + a bunch of other noises.
